def f(g):
    H=len(g);W=len(g[0])
    cells=[(i,j) for i in range(H) for j in range(W) if g[i][j]==3]
    rmin=min(i for i,_ in cells); rmax=max(i for i,_ in cells)

    def ring(i,j):
        d=max(abs(i-rmin),abs(i-rmax),abs(j-cmin),abs(j-cmax))

    for i in range(rmin+1,rmax):

            if d%2==1: out[i][j]=4
            else: out[i][j]=2
    # center of bounding box -> 3

def f(g):
    H=len(g);W=len(g[0])
    out=[r[:] for r in g]
    locs=[(i,j) for i in range(H) for j in range(W) if g[i][j]==3]
    rs=[p[0] for p in locs]; cs=[p[1] for p in locs]
    rmin,rmax,cmin,cmax=min(rs),max(rs),min(cs),max(cs)
    # interior strays: frame cells are those on bbox boundary
    def onframe(p): return p[0] in (rmin,rmax) or p[1] in (cmin,cmax)
    strays=[p for p in locs if not onframe(p)]
    if not strays: return out
    s=strays[0]
    for i in range(H):
        for j in range(W):
            if g[i][j]==0 and rmin<i<rmax and cmin<j<cmax:
                d=max(abs(i-s[0]),abs(j-s[1]))
                out[i][j]=4 if d%2 else 2
    return out
